multi_entity_note: Agreement between Cremer Oleo GmbH & Co KG and Ultragenyx Pharmaceutical Inc, with addresses in Germany and the USA.
processing_note: Purchase orders shall be submitted in any written or electronic form or by facsimile, setting out the quantity of Product required and the date for delivery.

contract.agreement_date.rationale: Signed at Hamburg on November 19th, 2012; September 26th, 2012 is the date of a separate confidentiality agreement.

contract.effective_date.rationale: Effective on the date of execution, which is November 19th, 2012.

contract.expiration_date.rationale: The initial term is three years from execution, not stated as a date.

contract.governing_law.rationale: Article 9 applies the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany; other Germany occurrences are an address and the jurisdiction place.

contract.renewal_term.rationale: Automatically renewed for additional two year periods.

contract.notice_period.rationale: Non-renewal notice must be given at least three calendar months before expiry.
